enable_truemoney.title: TrueMoney
enable_truemoney.groupDescription: Which promo sites to scrape. At least one must be enabled.

details.title: Fetch details
details.description: Fetch each promo's detail page for full terms, published_at, and modified_at. Adds one request per promo, so it roughly triples runtime (e.g. ~1 min to ~3 min for a full run).
details.groupDescription: Scrape options. All fields are optional.

maxItems.title: Max promos per site
maxItems.description: Cap the number of promos scraped per site per run, useful for a quick sample. 0 means no limit (scrape every promo on the page).

dailyDataset.title: Append to daily dataset
dailyDataset.description: Also append every promo to a named dataset promos-YYYY-MM-DD (Bangkok date), shared by all runs of that day, so a downstream reader gets every run of the day in one place. Daily datasets older than 30 days are deleted. Leave off for ad-hoc test runs.
